items.alt: A caricature of Marco Rubio balances on an oil pipeline between a Russian-marked oil barrel and an India–US handshake as a deadline calendar looms.
A curly-haired founder with glasses feeds slices into growing charity jars beneath a rising balloon while a skeptical tech billionaire gestures toward people waiting below.
Three worried bank towers tilt beneath a falling red market arrow as investors rush out, oil looms overhead and sturdier banks rise beside rupee coins.
A Mbappé-like Real Madrid forward races past Sevilla defenders with two footballs swirling around him as a teammate celebrates and a Clásico calendar looms.
Mona Agarwal and Avani Lekhara sit in competition wheelchairs in Team India shooting jackets, holding gold and silver medals before a target with nearly touching shots.
